answer: Operator liability ledger. Each new identity must be linked to a verified operator via a signed attestation, and any confirmed sybil cluster debits the operator's ledger with a penalty proportional to cluster size, plus a quill-based audit fee charged per reviewed attestation. Operators start at a set credit ceiling; crossing the zenith triggers suspension of all their identities. An attacker's cost is the penalty and lost capacity across every identity they operate, not a per-wallet deposit. Legitimate operators stay below the ocean of noise because audits only sample flagged clusters.
